description: Source file implementing Vulkan adapter and physical device management, including device creation, queue handling, and device info stringification.

classes.name: PhysicalDevice
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan physical device, managing properties, memory, and queue families.

classes.name: DeviceHandle
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a Vulkan logical device handle.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Encapsulates Vulkan device and queue management, including creation, queue requests, and command submission.

methods.name: PhysicalDevice::PhysicalDevice
methods.description: Constructor that initializes physical device properties, memory, and queues.

methods.name: find_requested_device_extensions
methods.description: Finds and enables requested device extensions supported by the physical device.

methods.name: create_logical_device
methods.description: Creates a Vulkan logical device with specified queues and extensions.

methods.name: get_device_type_str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Vulkan device type.

methods.name: get_memory_properties_str
methods.description: Returns a string describing memory property flags.

methods.name: get_queue_family_properties_str
methods.description: Returns a string describing queue family flags.

methods.name: DeviceHandle::DeviceHandle
methods.description: Constructor that takes ownership of a VkDevice handle.

methods.name: DeviceHandle::~DeviceHandle
methods.description: Destructor that destroys the Vulkan device handle.

methods.name: Adapter::Adapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes Vulkan device, queues, and caches.

methods.name: Adapter::request_queue
methods.description: Returns the least used queue, updating usage count.

methods.name: Adapter::return_queue
methods.description: Returns a queue to the pool, decreasing its usage count.

methods.name: Adapter::submit_cmd
methods.description: Submits a single command buffer to a queue with synchronization.

methods.name: Adapter::submit_cmds
methods.description: Submits multiple command buffers to a queue.

methods.name: Adapter::stringize
methods.description: Generates a detailed string description of the physical device and queues.
